inputs.text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict

output.main_topic: Ceasefire negotiations between the US and Iran amid the ongoing conflict
subtopics: Israel's stance on Iran's acceptance and pre-emptive strikes

central_relations.action: proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan

central_relations.subject: Iran
central_relations.action: seeking an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty
central_relations.object: an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty

central_relations.subject: Israel
central_relations.action: emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes

output.narrative_frame: The report frames the conflict as involving competing demands and scepticism that complicate efforts to reach a ceasefire.
opinions: Israel is sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasizes its right to pre-emptive strikes.
